description: Controlled concurrency qualification. Required Source writes are explicit; readiness files start as pending under outputs/. Each member calls run_python once: it writes exactly ready with no newline, sleeps, then prints the report already in the snapshot. It does not read release-gate.txt. The host opens the barrier after every member Chat reports ready.
